description: AUDIT P0: the Command-phase Battle-shock UI must actually RENDER for a human. Regression net for the fix where _setup_battle_shock_section early-returned during _ready (current_phase null) and was never rebuilt, so the controls never appeared. U_KOMMANDOS_H starts at exactly half-strength (11e battle-shock trigger); after it is queued, the CommandController must show a BattleShockSection carrying the RESOLVE BATTLE-SHOCK roll-call button plus a per-unit row, and that section must sit ABOVE THE FOLD of the command panel's scroll container so a real mouse click can reach it.
